title.value: RSAA PhD Scholarships (2026/27 round) for international applicants
title.evidence_quote: Applications are now open for the 2026/27 RSAA PhD Scholarship round.

institution.name: Research School of Astronomy and Astrophysics (RSAA), The Australian National University

qualifications: Single combined PDF application emailed to the RSAA international address by 15 November 2026
Three letters of reference, arriving no later than one week after the deadline
ANU English requirements must be met by successful applicants (not by the deadline)
